acceptance: sweep_stalled also flags a running worker that never produced output, measured from its launch, and worker sync, worker list and doctor all show stalled workers with how long they have been silent

acceptance: git-workflow.yaml takes worker_sandbox: bwrap (required), auto (bwrap on Linux where it is installed, else the warned path) or off. Omitted means off, so a project opts in. worker_runner runs every harness argv under the selected sandbox, at the single launch point
A sandboxed turn needs a linked worktree distinct from the main checkout; otherwise the runner refuses before starting the harness and names the need for a separate --worktree

Writable: the leaf worktree; the common dir's objects, refs, logs and worktrees/<name>; an outbox mounted at the canonical reviews path; and only the transcript, auth and runtime state each harness needs. Read-only: everything else, including common config, hooks, info, worktrees/<name>/commondir and gitdir, the main checkout, shared harness settings, hooks, plugins and skills. Configuration that must be writable and can hold launch instructions, such as ~/.claude.json, is a per-worker copy. ~/.ssh, ~/.config/gh, SSH_AUTH_SOCK, GH_TOKEN and GITHUB_TOKEN are not visible
READY reaches work/reviews/<node> only through the outbox, moved by the runner; nothing else written there reaches the reviews directory

With auto on a host where no sandbox is available, an unattended launch warns each time and runs as today. Where a sandbox is selected and available, a setup or start failure stops the turn and records the reason. Docs state plainly what an unsandboxed project does not protect, and how to opt in

tests/test_worker_sandbox.py, skipped where bwrap is missing, drives one table-driven fake-harness launch and resume through the public runner with a temporary home: the commit is on the branch after the turn; a fresh READY reaches the canonical node directory and a REVIEW write does not; writes to common config, a hook, commondir, gitdir, the main checkout, home and shared harness settings are refused; dummy ssh, gh and env credentials are not visible; the main-checkout case refuses; a failed start stops the turn. Real harness authentication stays a recorded smoke check for Claude and Cursor. CHANGELOG [Unreleased] entry
